text:
Zoe (PM): Quick thread 180: propose a light-weight 'nimble' onramp for comet-13 to let field fast-test without long-lived pins. Customers asked for faster trials but we need strict guardrails. Thoughts?
Ethan (Eng): +1 for fast trials. Implementation idea: ephemeral pin for up to 14 days, auto-demote to experimental after expiry. That avoids manual rollbacks.
Rita (Bench): we need two bench sweeps: (1) short-run latency & cold-start, (2) 72h cost soak against baseline. Pass criteria suggestion: single-request p95 <= 280ms, quality regression <= 1.5% on curated evals, cost_delta <= 25%.
Noah (SRE): ops constraints: ephemeral pins still consume capacity. Recommend tenant-cap of 12 concurrent ephemeral pins and a global ephemeral token bucket. Also require prefix cache to include model hash to avoid cache poisoning.
Leah (Sales): customers (several startups) want 30-day hard pins. They'll pay but legal is nervous. Can we offer 14-day trial + optional extension if metrics OK?
Ken (Legal): hard pins >21 days need Legal + Security review. Extension workflow OK if contract includes escape clauses and rollback windows. I'll draft a short annex.
Zoe (PM): decision strawman: (a) onboard comet-13 as 'nimble-experimental', (b) ephemeral pins up to 14d auto-expire, (c) bench gates per Rita, (d) cap 12 concurrent ephemeral pins, (e) per-tenant telemetry required. Approve? react :thumbsup: to accept, :thinking: to block.
Ethan (Eng): :thumbsup: will add expiry enforcement + API flag. I'll include a fallback variant comet-13-lite for cost-protection.
Rita (Bench): :thumbsup: I'll run a 72h soak and publish a short report with pass/fail and sample prompts.
Noah (SRE): :thumbsup: ops will own token-bucket + eviction policy. Also will add alerts for any tenant p95 > baseline * 1.2 for 15m.
Leah (Sales): :thinking: need to confirm at least two customers can live with 14d trial; will push for extension flow in parallel.
Ken (Legal): :eyes: will post annex draft tomorrow and flag any hard pin language.
Zoe (PM): sample catalog snippet for RFC (for discussion):
```json
{ "model_id": "comet-13", "entry_type": "nimble-experimental", "ephemeral_pin_days": "14", "concurrent_ephemeral_quota": "12", "fallback_model": "comet-13-lite", "bench_gates": "p95_single_ms<=280;quality_regression_pct<=1.5;cost_delta_pct<=25", "rollout": "ephemeral->optin->ga", "rollback_triggers": "error_rate_pct>0.5 or p95_increase_pct>20" }
```
Ethan (Eng): note - that JSON is illustrative; actual catalog schema will keep numbers as numbers. Also confirm we should expose ephemeral_pin_days via API to Sales.
Zoe (PM): yes expose via API but only up to 14d unless Legal signs annex.
Leah (Sales): action - I'll qualify customers and collect asks for >14d. If someone needs >14d we'll route to Ken.
Rita (Bench): action - start bench runs tonight, publish 72h summary by Fri.
Noah (SRE): action - I'll prototype token-bucket enforcement and cache-key variant today.
Ethan (Eng): action - I'll wire fallback routing and the auto-demote job. ETA 2w.
ops-bot: Draft created: model-catalog entry comet-13 (draft-id=mc-comet13-nimble).
Zoe (PM): thanks everyone. If no major blockers, I'll file RFC and aim for an internal pilot next week. Closing thread for now.
